title: Hyperkähler SYZ (Lagrangian Fibration) Conjecture
exact_target: Must every nontrivial nef isotropic line bundle on an irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifold become globally generated after taking a positive power?

sources.citation: Andrey Soldatenkov and Misha Verbitsky, The abundance and SYZ conjectures in families of hyperkähler manifolds, Épijournal 9 (2025), Article 26.
